headline: Live updates on Iran: tanker attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
summary: The UKMTO maritime security agency reported an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. Talks between the United States and Iran remain stalled despite a memorandum of understanding signed in June.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of global seaborne oil passes, so disruptions there can quickly affect crude prices.
why_moved: An attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, with stalled US-Iran talks, raises concern about disruption to oil shipments through a key chokepoint.
